title: 2008 Upper Deck Starquest Common #SQ-57 Russell Martin Los Angeles LA Dodgers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2008 Upper Deck Starquest Common #SQ-57 trading card features Russell Martin, a major league baseball player from the Los Angeles Dodgers team. The card is a part of the 2008 Upper Deck First Edition set and is a common parallel/variety with an insert feature. It is a sports trading card of size standard, manufactured by Upper Deck in the year 2008. 

The card is not autographed and is a part of the Starquest insert set. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection and is perfect for those who love to collect trading cards. Get your hands on this card now and add it to your sports memorabilia collection!
